Chapter 1141 - 9: Everything Is Ready (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 1141: Chapter 9: Everything Is Ready (Subscription Requested)_2

It’s never wrong to consider things from the worst possible outcome.

After all, Lin Yuan’s departure in his true form really will put human civilization in a relatively vulnerable state.

"Alright."

The Xuanyuan Supreme and Xia Qin Supreme did not know why Lin Yuan left in his true form, but they did not ask further.

...

Having chosen the Chaos Realm secret treasure to bring along, Lin Yuan’s true form quietly disappeared from the ’Fragment World of Star Tears’.

Outside the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

It is his first time, in his true form, coming so close to the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Previously, all his contact with the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was through casually created avatars.

Buzz!

Lin Yuan stepped into the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

In an instant, he appeared in the deepest space.

The Eye of Myriad Laws seemed to have never left, always waiting there.

"Hm?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws glanced at Lin Yuan, showing a hint of surprise.

"No wonder you dare to contest in the Xuan Huang Universe..." The Eye of Myriad Laws remarked in slight astonishment.

Even with a casual look, it could vaguely sense how profound Lin Yuan’s foundation was, surpassing even the usual Chaos Great Saints.

And this is just the Sovereign Realm.

"If the Sovereign Realm is already like this, what will become when you step into the Chaos Realm, reaching its perfection? Wouldn’t you be an invincible Great Saint?" pondered the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Originally, the Eye of Myriad Laws investing in Lin Yuan was risky, for example if Lin Yuan did not reach the thirteenth stage in the future.

Not even an exceptional Great Saint is worth the investment from the Eye of Myriad Laws.

But if he were an invincible Great Saint? Such a Great Saint could sweep over other exceptional Great Saints of the same era.

Even the mighty Xuanhuang of old wasn’t considered an invincible Great Saint.

Usually, only one invincible Great Saint might emerge during a Chaos Void era.

Often, there are no invincible Great Saints at all, as the power of exceptional Great Saints mostly reaches a limit, none able to sweep the others.

To nurture an invincible Great Saint? It’s exceedingly difficult.

At this moment, the Eye of Myriad Laws believed that Lin Yuan’s future would be either as a thirteenth stage temporal being or as an invincible Great Saint.

A promise from an invincible Great Saint is not a loss to the Eye of Myriad Laws.

"Seems my foresight wasn’t bad," thought the Eye of Myriad Laws, feeling pleased.

"When will the transmission occur?" Lin Yuan asked.

"No hurry, we can begin now," the Eye of Myriad Laws replied with a smile.

"By the way."

The Eye of Myriad Laws seemed to remember something, reminding, "This appearance of the Xuan Huang Universe has attracted many Great Saints. Several have approached me, wanting me to send them near the Xuan Huang Universe..."

The ability and techniques of the Eye of Myriad Laws aren’t considered a secret among Great Saints, as many Chaos Great Saints, being too far away to reach the Xuan Huang Universe, would seek help from the Eye of Myriad Laws.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

When he headed there in his true form, he was prepared for the worst and had anticipated these scenarios.

"Do not resist now."

The Eye of Myriad Laws gazed down at Lin Yuan, the surrounding fluctuations of space-time subtly growing intense.

...

Qinglan Void Domain.

Within one Chaos Continent’s Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

A figure coalesced, striding in.

The figure was tall, exuding an aura of wild archaic essence, appearing instantly within the deepest space of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

"Greetings, Wild Barbarian Great Saint."

The Pavilion Master of this Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion had been waiting for a while, bowing slightly to the tall figure out of respect.

"I seek the Eye of Myriad Laws."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint stated.

"Yes."

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion immediately began to contact the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Before long.

Space-time slowly began to rotate, a giant eyeball formed, looking down at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

"Wild Barbarian, what do you want with me?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws spoke calmly, without a hint of fluctuation.

"I want to go to this space-time coordinate location."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint dove straight to the point.

"You also wish to go to that Xuan Huang Universe?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

"Indeed, I once read in the records of a broken ruin about this unparalleled Great Saint, and the Postnatal Universe he developed is quite valuable."

said the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

Originally, he wanted to keep this matter hidden without disclosing the information about that Postnatal Universe, but the Eye of Myriad Laws directly revealed the name of the Postnatal Universe.

So the Wild Barbarian Great Saint did not continue to conceal it.

"No problem."

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded: "However, you know I always prefer fair trade."

"Okay, tell me."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint nodded.

"Ten billion Chaos Stones, or ten Great Saint-level weapon treasures."

The Eye of Myriad Laws named the price.

"Ten billion Chaos Stones?"

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s eye twitched.

Even though he had prepared himself to be fleeced by the Eye of Myriad Laws before he came, he still felt a tremor in his heart upon hearing the offer.

Ten billion Chaos Stones? Even for a Chaos Great Saint, ten billion Chaos Stones is a massive amount, and as for ten pieces of Great Saint-level weapon treasures, even more so.

The distance between Qinglan Void Domain and that Xuanhuang Universe is only a few decades’ worth of traveling effort for the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

If it weren’t for the fear of running out of time, he would have gone there himself.

But now, just for one teleportation, he has to pay ten billion Chaos Stones?

"If you’re unwilling, then forget it."

The Eye of Myriad Laws immediately said.

"Willing, I’m definitely willing."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint took a deep breath and looked at the Eye of Myriad Laws: "But can it be a bit cheaper? I don’t have that many Chaos Stones on me right now."

"Then how much do you have?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws directly asked.

"Three billion Chaos Stones, two Great Saint weapons."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint said: "Those two Great Saint weapons cannot be given to you, otherwise my combat power will decrease, and even if I reach the Xuanhuang Universe, I won’t be able to obtain anything valuable."

"Three billion Chaos Stones, it’s too little."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said.

He was unwilling to fleece Lin Yuan, but that didn’t mean he wouldn’t fleece these Chaos Great Saints.

Eventually, the Wild Barbarian Great Saint and the Eye of Myriad Laws reached an agreement, exchanging three billion Chaos Stones and thirty percent of his gains from the Xuanhuang Universe for the opportunity to be teleported near the Xuanhuang Universe.

"You do nothing and get thirty percent of the gains?" The Wild Barbarian Great Saint felt rather helpless.

"You can also choose to pay ten billion Chaos Stones." The Eye of Myriad Laws said.

"Then forget it."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint shook his head. Although he was certain of the great value of the Xuanhuang Universe, he couldn’t ensure that his thirty percent gains from it would exceed seven billion Chaos Stones.

The primary goal of the Wild Barbarian Great Saint was also His Majesty Xuanhuang’s exploration and understanding of the thirteenth stage.

...

In a mysterious place within the Chaos Void.

A Chaos Great Saint with two horns on his head appeared before an ancient, mottled altar.

"Great Altar Spirit, I wish to travel to this spatial coordinate in the shortest time possible." The two-horned Great Saint spoke.

Buzz—

The ancient, mottled altar slightly trembled, and a voice rang in the two-horned Great Saint’s ear.

"I want sixty percent of your gains from this journey."

"Sixty percent of the gains?" The two-horned Great Saint fell silent, handing over sixty percent of the spoils he risked battling with other Great Saints to the altar?

The two-horned Great Saint understood the altar’s capabilities and methods; once sixty percent of the gains were set, it would not change.

Even if he wanted to hide, he couldn’t.

"Then tell me, to which unparalleled Great Saint does this Postnatal Universe belong?"

The two-horned Great Saint was unwilling to make a wasted trip, only to end up ’working’ for the altar, so he wanted to first understand the origins of that Postnatal Universe.

If it only belonged to an ordinary unparalleled Great Saint, then there was no need to pay such a price to go there.

In battling other Great Saints, he too would incur losses, and he didn’t want his forty percent share of the gains to not even cover those losses.

"That universe is called the Xuanhuang Universe, left behind by the Xuanhuang Great Saint."

"The Xuanhuang Great Saint was one of the unparalleled Great Saints closest to becoming an Invincible Great Saint in that era."

A voice from the ancient, mottled altar resounded in the two-horned Great Saint’s ears.

"An unparalleled Great Saint closest to an Invincible Great Saint?" The two-horned Great Saint’s expression changed slightly, as Invincible Great Saints only existed in legend.

To become an Invincible Great Saint, one must first sweep through all unparalleled Great Saints of one’s time.

And be universally acknowledged by all unparalleled Great Saints of that time.

But achieving this requires terrifying strength; it’s not just about defeating a certain unparalleled Great Saint to gain that recognition.

"Then sixty percent of the gains it is."

The two-horned Great Saint agreed.

An unparalleled Great Saint approaching the level of an Invincible Great Saint—traveling to the Postnatal Universe he developed was worth paying such a price.
